title: How Sink Drainage Works: Understanding Traps and Venting
description: Every functional sink drainage system relies on a careful balance of gravity, hydraulic flow, and air pressure. At the heart of this system is the P-trap, a curved section of pipe located directly beneath the fixture. The primary function of the P-trap is to hold a standing plug of water that blocks sewer gases from entering the living space. Downstream of the trap, the drainage system connects to a vent stack, which introduces atmospheric air into the pipes. This venting prevents negative pressure from siphoning the trap water seal during heavy discharges. Understanding this mechanism helps technicians troubleshoot complex drainage issues and ensures safe, odor-free installations.
